_about: New factual questions for bench/split-gain.js, aimed at sections of the 9 large notes (>5,000 tokens) that bench/questions.json does not already cover. Same schema as bench/questions.json: `expect` is a case-insensitive regex the final answer must match; `notes` are the notes that hold the answer. All facts are deterministic (bench/generate.js, seed 42) or fixed content of demo/memory (reference-incident-log) — verified against the actually generated files, not guessed.

questions.q: What is our account number with Drift Hosting?
What is our account number with Rook Security?
In the network inventory, what is the name of the switch in rack A?
According to the API catalogue, what is the rate limit of the Maps API?
At the Lantern review meeting of 2 October 2025, were change-request costs already added to the original fixed price?
How many minutes did it take to fix the Git server incident of 11 August 2025?
